statements.status_notes: nodemailer@7.0.11 is affected by GHSA-c7w3-x93f-qmm8 (LOW severity CRLF injection). The fix lands in nodemailer@8.0.4. nodemailer is currently pinned to 7.0.11 in this build to remediate CVE-2025-14874; moving to the 8.x line is a major version bump that requires validating langfuse's email transport behavior and is not yet adopted. Exploitation requires control over message header content, which langfuse-worker derives from operator-configured templates rather than untrusted input.
